title: Silent 24-route cap removes valid endpoints from generated navigation and retrieval evidence
observed_behavior: Route extraction sorts unique values and silently slices them to 24; Python extraction first caps regex routes at 24 and caps the combined regex/decorator list again. collect_context_records copies that incomplete tuple into api_routes and derives relevance_terms from it, so every downstream summary, PROJECT_INDEX record, feature score, and route-aware retrieval candidate sees only the alphabetically first 24 endpoints.
expected_invariant: Generated summaries and typed context records must either preserve every discovered API route or explicitly represent and surface truncation so navigation, ownership maps, and exact-route retrieval cannot mistake a bounded display for a complete contract inventory.
root_cause: A display-size helper is used as the authoritative extraction data model. The hard-coded limit has no overflow count, truncation flag, continuation artifact, validation failure, or separate complete route set for typed records.
failure_scenario: A route contract grows beyond 24 endpoints. Alphabetically later routes disappear from generated summaries and PROJECT_INDEX, and their route-specific terms cannot contribute to feature scoring or retrieval. An agent following the required generated-summary-first workflow can therefore miss active routes and their ownership/tests while believing the generated record is complete.
evidence: Current context_extractors.py SHA-256 is 651e762b46634ab6c7e6de2f793a5af3b701f052f3de36c24eb3d8102894dbae; lines 126-127 implement silent sorted slicing, lines 181-182 cap generic routes, and line 236 caps the Python aggregate again.
Current context_records.py SHA-256 is 5a57e553d0bb6f58988a5bacfe4ee658e9b88d896bd4ee0e911467a363e7fb9d; lines 791 and 803 propagate the capped tuple into api_routes and relevance_terms.

Concrete current-tree witness src/mediapipeline/contracts/api_routes_command_settings_ui.py has SHA-256 ed47c470be1cef4ebafd52a4ae7b6840df1083511005b0c595b23ff29409011b and 27 distinct /api routes, while extract_source and collect_context_records each return 24.

The exact omitted witnesses are /api/settings/wizard/validate-tools, /api/settings/wizard/validate-workers, and /api/ui-preferences. The hash-matched generated summary and PROJECT_INDEX record omit all three; PROJECT_INDEX relevance_terms also omit tools, workers, and preferences.
A search across current worker finding fragments found no matching root cause before publication.
affected_flows: feature scoring and route ownership navigation
existing_safeguards: Generated artifacts carry exact source hashes and generator fingerprints, and generator drift checks can prove byte freshness.
safeguard_gap: Freshness checks faithfully reproduce the incomplete capped record; no schema field or validation tells consumers that routes were discarded.
tests_present: tests/python/tooling/test_context_records.py exercises route extraction and typed-record construction for smaller fixtures.
Generated-output checks validate deterministic reproduction of current artifacts.
tests_missing: A source fixture with more than 24 distinct routes and an assertion that every route remains discoverable.
Overflow/truncation metadata propagation and rendering tests if bounded displays are retained.
Exact-route retrieval cases for alphabetically late endpoints.
recommended_remediation: Keep an uncapped authoritative route tuple in ExtractedSource and ContextRecord. If summaries need a display budget, truncate only while rendering and emit an explicit omitted-count/continuation marker; add overflow tests and regenerate all navigation artifacts.
remediation_risk: low to medium: generated files and retrieval ranking will change, and larger records may affect token budgets, but production route behavior is unchanged
validation_rung: Focused context extractor/record/summary/context-slice tests with a greater-than-24-route fixture, all generated-context --check modes, PROJECT_INDEX integrity checks, and exact-route retrieval probes.
prior_audit_relationship: New current-audit root cause; no matching finding exists in the prior or current scoped worker fragments.
